name: a6fdvd-u13-hub-gate-pages
goal: U13 hub gate pages (invitation, device approval) have one h1 and no h2 in the card, a narrow centred card of at most 480px at 1440, a monospace code field, and fields and buttons of at least 44px; a rendered-browser test fails on main and passes after the change

evidence: The invitation and device approval pages should each have one heading, a centered narrow card and touch-size code entry controls.

The committed gate browser case covers both routes at phone, tablet and laptop sizes. The replay freezes all final tests before applying the product repair because the original fix also updated hosted-native.spec.ts.
The unchanged gate case on test-only commit d78578b320 failed with two headings where one was expected.
Commit 85d89ffd19 applies the original fix and matches PR #246 commit bb1932ef06 byte for byte.
The same Chromium gate test passes all six cases at 85d89ffd19.
